observations: Black metal sewing machine with a decorative cast iron stand.
The machine head is visible with a needle and presser foot.
The stand features a large hand crank on the right and a foot pedal at the base.
The machine appears to be in good structural condition with no visible rust or major damage.
The background is a plain white studio setting, not a home environment.

claims.evidence: The studio photo is a stock image, not a photo of the actual item being sold.
The photos do not show the actual machine in a home setting to verify completeness.
No photo shows the machine powered on or actively sewing.
No photo shows the actual flat plate.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be seized.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running with the motor engaged.

risks.risk: The needle or presser foot may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine head with all components visible.

risks.risk: The crank or pedal may be broken or seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the crank being turned and the pedal being used.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and running.
Photo of the actual machine in a home setting.
Photo of the machine head with the needle and presser foot.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
